svg.title: Complete wiring for one pad: Grove temperature sensor plus amber and green LEDs
svg.desc: One pad module contains three components. The Grove temperature sensor's SIG wire goes to an analog pin, its VCC to the 5 volt rail and its GND to the ground rail. The amber LED's long leg goes through a 330 ohm resistor to one digital pin and its short leg to the ground rail. The green LED's long leg goes through its own 330 ohm resistor to a second digital pin and its short leg also to the ground rail. A shared 5 volt rail runs along the top and a shared ground rail along the bottom, both returning to the Arduino. A table below lists the pin differences between the ring cradle and the palm pad.
svg.text: One pad, completely wired — sensor + amber + green
Shown for the ring cradle. The palm pad is identical with different pins (table at bottom).
shared ground rail → Arduino GND pin · all three components land here
